User guides

Prepare data, discuss results and revise your plans.

title: 建模方法
Modeling methods
description: 了解每种方法怎样建立、检查和修正模型。
See how each method builds, checks and repairs models.

title: 建模库与求解器
Libraries & solvers
description: 选择模型表达方式与实际计算引擎。
Choose a modeling library and a compatible solver backend.

title: 部署与参考
Deployment & reference
description: 部署服务、设置用量、排查问题。
Deploy the service, configure usage and resolve problems.

title: LLM4OM 文档
LLM4OM documentation
summary: 从第一次建模，到选择方法与部署平台。
From your first optimization problem to methods, solvers and deployment.

title: 完成第一个方案
Your first plan
summary: 用一个生产问题体验建模、求解与条件调整。
Build, solve and revise a small production plan.

title: 安装与启动
Install and launch
summary: 使用 Docker Compose 或本地 Python 环境启动平台。
Start the platform with Docker Compose or a local Python environment.

title: 理解一次建模
How modeling works
summary: 区分建模方法、大模型、建模库、求解器和运行记录。
Understand methods, LLMs, modeling libraries, solvers and saved runs.

title: Chat Agent 优化对话
Chat Agent
summary: 通过连续对话完成需求沟通、计算和方案调整。
Describe a problem, compute a plan and make changes through conversation.

title: 整理需求
Clarify requirements
summary: 把初步想法整理成可编辑的问题与数据。
Turn an initial idea into an editable problem statement and data.

title: 上传与编辑数据
Upload and edit data
summary: 检查表格、字段和单位，保留完整数据用于计算。
Review spreadsheets, fields and units before computing with the full data.

title: 配置与启动建模
Configure a run
summary: 选择建模方法、建模库、求解后端和预设模型。
Select a method, modeling library, solver backend and LLM preset.

title: 查看与导出结果
Review and export results
summary: 核对实际决策、数学模型和求解状态，导出完整方案。
Inspect decisions, the model and solver status, then export the full plan.

title: 讨论与核对方案
Discuss a saved plan
summary: 询问方案含义、计算费用与余量，或从当前方案继续建模。
Explain decisions, calculate totals and continue from the current plan.

title: 调整条件
Revise requirements
summary: 改变已有问题的要求，保留原方案并比较变化。
Change a requirement while keeping the original plan for comparison.

title: 比较业务场景
Compare business scenarios
summary: 从共同基准分别计算不同需求或资源条件。
Compare demand or resource changes from one fixed baseline.

title: 比较方法与模型
Compare methods and LLMs
summary: 对同一问题运行不同方法或大模型，核对结果和用量。
Run different methods or LLMs on the same problem and inspect the results.

title: 理解无解与冲突
Understand infeasibility
summary: 根据求解证据核对不能同时满足的要求。
Use solver evidence to inspect requirements that cannot hold together.

title: 历史、标签与报告
History, tags and reports
summary: 查找相关方案、记录结论并导出可分享的报告。
Find related plans, record conclusions and export reports.

title: 示例与公开题库
Examples and benchmarks
summary: 从内置示例开始，了解公开题面的范围与来源。
Start from built-in examples and explore public benchmark problems.

title: 配置大模型
Configure LLM presets
summary: 连接模型服务，管理固定预设与服务商参数。
Connect model services and manage fixed presets and provider parameters.

title: 选择建模方法
Choose a modeling method
summary: 比较 13 种方法的流程、问题范围和使用方式。
Compare the workflows, scope and configuration of 13 methods.

title: Direct
Direct
summary: 一次生成数学模型与求解代码，再交给求解器计算。
Generate the mathematical model and solver code in one LLM call.

title: Feedback Repair
Feedback Repair
summary: 求解后对照原题复核，并按具体问题修正。
Review the solved model against the problem and repair specific errors.

title: TriVAL
TriVAL
summary: 依次验证语义、数学模型与代码，必要时回溯修订。
Validate semantics, formulation and code, with revisions across stages.

title: OptiMUS 0.3
OptiMUS 0.3
summary: 提取参数、目标和约束，逐项建模并组装代码。
Extract parameters, objectives and constraints, then assemble component code.

title: Chain-of-Experts
Chain-of-Experts
summary: 协调者依次选择专家，汇总意见后生成模型和代码。
A conductor selects experts in sequence before a reducer produces the model.

title: OptiTree
OptiTree
summary: 沿问题类型树匹配建模思路，再生成并检查代码。
Match a problem type in a tree, retrieve guidance and generate code.

title: OR-LLM-Agent
OR-LLM-Agent
summary: 先建立数学模型，再写代码，结合执行反馈修复与复查。
Build the formulation first, then generate, execute and recheck code.

title: ORThought
ORThought
summary: 按建模顺序写出思路、数学模型和代码，并调试执行错误。
Write a reasoning path, formulation and code, then debug execution errors.

title: LLMOPT
LLMOPT
summary: 构造五要素模型，再根据自我校正回到相应步骤。
Construct a five-part formulation and route corrections to the affected stage.

title: AutoFormulation
AutoFormulation
summary: 搜索多个模型组件，用 MCTS 和两两比较选择完整模型。
Search candidate components and rank complete models with MCTS and comparisons.

title: SAC-Opt
SAC-Opt
summary: 提取语义锚点，回译约束代码，只修正未通过的组件。
Extract semantic anchors and selectively repair constraints after backtranslation.

title: BIND
BIND
summary: 向模型提供数据结构，由求解代码读取完整附件。
Show data structure to the LLM and read complete attachments during execution.

title: OptiMind
OptiMind
summary: 结合公开类型提示与多轮求解反馈检查模型。
Combine public problem-type hints with multi-turn solver feedback.

title: 选择建模库与求解器
Choose a library and solver
summary: 了解九个建模库，以及后端能力、AUTO 和实际可用状态。
Understand the nine libraries, backend capabilities, AUTO and availability.

title: Pyomo
Pyomo
summary: 用代数方式表达模型，并连接兼容的原生求解后端。
Express algebraic models and connect compatible native backends.

title: gurobipy / Gurobi
gurobipy / Gurobi
summary: 使用 Gurobi 的原生 Python 模型、矩阵接口与冲突诊断。
Use Gurobi's native Python models, matrix API and conflict evidence.

title: OR-Tools
OR-Tools
summary: 覆盖线性、整数、约束、路径与网络流等原生接口。
Use native linear, integer, constraint, routing and network-flow interfaces.

title: CPMpy
CPMpy
summary: 用整数、布尔与全局约束表达离散决策。
Model discrete decisions with integer, Boolean and global constraints.

title: PuLP
PuLP
summary: 表达线性与混合整数模型，连接 CBC 等原生后端。
Build linear and mixed-integer models with CBC or other native backends.

title: CVXPY
CVXPY
summary: 表达凸优化模型，选择支持相应锥与变量域的后端。
Model convex optimization and select a backend for its cones and domains.

title: PySCIPOpt / SCIP
PySCIPOpt / SCIP
summary: 使用原生 SCIP 表达线性、整数及非线性约束。
Use native SCIP for linear, integer and nonlinear constraints.

title: CasADi
CasADi
summary: 表达光滑非线性模型，理解插件与局部求解状态。
Express smooth nonlinear models and understand plugin and local-solution semantics.

title: coptpy / COPT
coptpy / COPT
summary: 使用 COPT 原生接口，核对模型类型与许可条件。
Use the native COPT interface and check model and license requirements.

title: 求解后端与许可证
Backends and licenses
summary: 认识常用引擎、安装状态、显式选择与许可证配置。
Understand common engines, availability, explicit selection and licenses.

title: 团队部署
Team deployment
summary: 通过 Docker Compose、HTTPS 和访问限制部署共享服务。
Deploy a shared service with Docker Compose, HTTPS and access controls.

title: 配置、用量与备份
Configuration, usage and backups
summary: 配置模型、运行并发、用量上限与持久化数据。
Configure LLMs, concurrency, usage limits and persistent storage.

title: 命令行与 Python
CLI and Python
summary: 通过命令行或 Python 运行相同的建模流程。
Run the same modeling workflows from the CLI or Python.

title: 常见问题与排查
Troubleshooting
summary: 根据实际错误定位连接、模型、求解与结果问题。
Resolve connection, LLM, solver and result issues from the actual error.
